newsitem.title: USA: US House panel likely to consider tax bill June 11.
newsitem.headline: US House panel likely to consider tax bill June 11.

text.p: The House tax-writing committee is likely to take up consideration of tax legislation next Wednesday, the panel's chairman said Thursday.
The House Ways and Means committee is tentatively scheduled to consider the bill at 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) Wednesday, committee chairman Bill Archer, a Texas Republican, told reporters.
He said he planned to finish putting together the tax bill this weekend. Congressional leaders and the White House last month agreed to an $85 billion net tax cut over five years.
"I have not completed my mark and I will not complete it until this weekend," Archer said referring to the tax bill.
The budget agreement outline called for $135 billion in total tax reduction over five years, offset by $50 billion in revenue raisers.
The airline ticket tax is expected to raise $32.5 billion over five years.
"What we can raise on top of that is not going to be easy, we'll raise some additional revenue," Archer said.
